headline: Bank of Korea Projects Economic Growth of 3.9% for 2026
summary: The Bank of Korea forecasts GDP growth of 3.9% in 2026, 4.1% in 2027, and 3.0% in 2028. Growth is expected to be driven by strong semiconductor exports, though officials noted risks from Middle East instability and potential U.S. policy shifts.
why: The Bank of Korea is the central bank of South Korea, responsible for monetary policy and economic stability. Its growth forecasts are key indicators for investors monitoring the health of the export-oriented South Korean economy.

impacts.name: KOSPI
impacts.why: Positive GDP growth projections generally support investor sentiment for the domestic equity market.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The positive growth outlook, supported by semiconductor demand, provides a favorable signal for the South Korean economy and its major export-driven industries.
